title: Newton's Cradle
description: The desk toy, in pure CSS: five steel balls, one endless argument about momentum.
usage: No script at all — two keyframes and a delay keep the end balls trading blows forever. It belongs wherever a page waits: loading states, "we are thinking" panels, the footer of a site with confidence. The middle three balls do nothing, beautifully, which is also a management style.
a11y: A silent, looping ornament: aria-hidden, with the page’s real status carried in words beside it. Under prefers-reduced-motion the balls hang still — momentum, conserved at zero.
